# @bepalo/cache

> 标签: bun cache, cache, cache performance, cache store, cache utility, custom expiration, data caching, deno cache, eviction policy, expiry, fast cache, in-memory, javascript cache, lightweight cache, local cache, lru, memory cache, nodejs cache, ttl

## 简介

A fast and modern in-memory cache library with TTL and LRU for javascript runtimes.
